conventions.coordinates: [m, A, B] denotes sorted physical heaps (m, m + A, m + A + B) with 1-based layer indexing j >= 1 (A_j = Y_j - m, B_j = Z_j - Y_j), following Sun & Zeilberger (Ann. Comb. 8, 2004, pp. 225-238).
conventions.threshold_indexing: N1, N2, N3 follow the Table 1 >= convention (first index from which the condition holds continuously up to the verified horizon).
conventions.midpoint_formula_note: On p. 235 of Sun & Zeilberger (2004), alpha' is printed as floor((max - min)/2), a typographical minus sign for floor((max + min)/2). Table 1 and Claim 3.5's separation hypothesis alpha_0 - alpha' >= 4m (with alpha_0 = 0) require (max + min)//2. Both the half-sum Claim 3.5 checks and the direct Lemma 2.6 induction proof are verified.
